_comment: Badges AxmaT draws after a name. The app reads this file from the repository at startup and every five minutes, so a badge is added by editing it here -- no new build, no update.

_fields.id: anything, as long as it is unique
_fields.users: TikTok account ids, the numeric ones that do not change with the username
_fields.image: a path in this repository; leave it out for the mod's own note
_fields.colour: RRGGBB to paint the image with; leave it out to keep its own colours
_fields.title: the heading of the window the badge opens
_fields.*_ru, *_uk: the same field in that language; the app picks by the phone's language

badges.title: AxmaT
badges.text: The owner of Axmat and AxmaT
